usage: sigmoid(tag_logits) >= per-tag threshold (below) -> tag; softmax(severity_logits) argmax+1. Danger tags (threat/physical-violence/sexual) pinned to 0.35 for recall; other thresholds tuned on the held-out gold eval (F1-optimal in [0.40,0.70], default 0.50 when support is thin); coercive-control raised to keep benign messages from firing.
